info.name: DES-QA-07 | Sprint 3 API contract preflight (read-only)
info.description: GET-only readiness inventory. Passing requests are not QR/Rewards/payment business testcase passes. Compare the same staging build before using this as evidence.

exec: pm.test('Version before: HTTP 200 and commit', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().commit).to.match(/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/); });

const patterns = { qr: /qr/i, rewards: /reward|customer|member/i, payment_v2: /payments|split-bill/i, table_advanced: /transfer|merge|split/i, modifier: /modifier/i, inventory: /ingredient|stock|recipe/i };

Object.entries(patterns).forEach(([name, regex]) => { const found = operations.filter(x => regex.test(x)); console.log(`[DES-QA-07] ${name}: ${found.length} operation(s): ${found.join('; ') || 'none'}`); });
console.log(`[DES-QA-07] OpenAPI: ${Object.keys(paths).length} paths, ${operations.length} REST operations. Readiness only; absent route => pending/blocked business test.`);
pm.test('No write operation executed by preflight', () => pm.expect(pm.request.method).to.eql('GET'));
pm.test('Version after: same staging commit', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().commit).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('stagingCommit')); });
